messages:
Kai (Onboarding): FYI prepping a warm-start for @AcmeHealth tomorrow at 10:00am PT — want to align on SLO smoke tests + credit comms.
Maya (CSM): Thanks — what's in scope? Their contract lists uptime + latency targets. Need clear acceptance criteria so I can tell the customer.
Kai (Onboarding): Plan: 30m prewarm to populate caches (prefix/KV), then a 10m smoke ramp at cutover. Success criteria: p50 < 100ms, p95 < 250ms for text generation endpoints during the 10m window; error rate <= 1% overall.
Ravi (SRE): Cool. We'll run the synthetic harness from us-east and eu-west to approximate their traffic. I'll add a runbook step to temporarily relax autoscaler cooldowns and an alert suppression window.
Jordan (Solutions): Customer expects no surprises — recommend we prepare a short one‑pager that outlines what we'll do, what transient behavior to expect, and the credit policy if SLOs are missed. I'll draft that.
Kai (Onboarding): Runbook snippet for the smoke test (for ops):
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do \n  curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"input":"warmup"}' \n  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate > /dev/null; \n  sleep 0.15; \ndone
```
Ravi (SRE): Nice. Also enable detailed latency breakdown in Console (token-time, model-infer, network) and tag traces with `warmstart_acme`. That'll help root cause any p95 spikes.
Ollie (Support): Don't forget to create a support alias so any customer tickets during the window are auto-tagged. I'll create `acme-warmstart` and stand by.
Maya (CSM): How will we compute credit exposure if p95 > 250ms at cutover? Need pre-approval from finance/legal so we can expedite any customer comms.
Priya (Finance): If it's a short transient (<1 hour) we follow the SLA cap table. Send me the precise acceptance window and we'll pre-compute worst-case credits so CS can discuss on the call.
Kai (Onboarding): @Priya window = 10m during cutover + 30m stabilization after cutover. We'll attach the synthetic logs and Console traces.
Ravi (SRE): Ops note: I'll turn on verbose tracing for the window and take a snapshot of model variant placement. Also will capture CPU/GPU load and batching stats.
Jordan (Solutions): One-pager draft uploaded: https://drive.internal/redwood/docs/acme-warmstart-onepager — pls comment, especially on the customer-facing wording and the credit paragraph.
Maya (CSM): Who owns customer comms? I'll be on the bridge but need an email draft to send 1 hour before to set expectations.
Kai (Onboarding): I can take the email. Draft outline: 1) short bulleted expectations, 2) SLO targets and allowed transient errors, 3) contact points (CS, SRE, Support), 4) where to view live metrics (Console link), 5) post-window next steps.
Ollie (Support): I'll be on Slack #support and will monitor the `acme-warmstart` tag. Ping me 5m before start and I'll escalate if we see >1% errors.
OpsBot: Schedule created: warm-start-acme at 1768531200 (tomorrow 10:00 PT). Reminder set for 30m prior.
Maya (CSM): :thumbsup: Action items: Kai - email draft + runbook link; Ravi - runbook + tracing + autoscale tweak; Jordan - one-pager comments; Ollie - support tag; Priya - credit calc. Please update this thread when each item is done.
Kai (Onboarding): Will post runbook link and sample curl logs here when ready. ETA 15:00 today.
